en.title: The Lapis Lazuli Soiree and the Forgotten Testament
en.premise: Ellis, the daughter of a fallen noble house, returns to the royal balls of her youth, clutching two legacies from her late father: a broken pocket watch and a mysterious will. But awaiting her is the cold-hearted young Duke Kyle and a cruel conspiracy that threatens the very foundation of the kingdom. As lies hidden beneath the swirl of dancing gowns are unveiled and frozen time begins to tick once more, a true love begins to bloom.

zh.title: 瑠璃色的夜会与忘却的遗言
zh.premise: 没落名门之女艾莉丝，手持亡父留下的“损坏的怀表”与“神秘的遗书”，再次踏入王宫的舞会。然而，在那里等待她的，是冷酷的年轻公爵凯尔，以及一场足以撼动国家的残酷阴谋。当舞裙裙摆下隐藏的谎言被揭穿，停滞的时间重新开始流动，真挚的爱恋将悄然绽放。
